script.text: Astral found himself becoming more and more acclimated to this new world that he found himself in.
And as part of that, he became addicted to the enthralling action of the hit TV show starring The Sparrow. He identified with the lead character who was also from another world.
Not understanding TV, he encouraged Yuma to seek out The Sparrow's help. But Yuma was not hearing it. However, the next day at school, his friend Tori brought him some news...
Hey, Yuma. Did you hear?
The Sparrow is down by the seaport! They built a set down on Southstreet!
We cannot squander this opportunity, Yuma. If The Sparrow really arrived here through a dimensional vortex, then there’s a chance that he might know something about me and my missing memories.
Astral truly thought The Sparrow might hold the key to his lost memories, while Tori wanted to indulge her school girl crush. And so Yuma reluctantly agreed to try to see The Sparrow.
It wasn't long before they found themselves sneaking onto the TV show's set and taking a peek at The Sparrow.

Unfortunately, due to a mishap, Yuma and his friends were discovered, and in the process, Yuma dropped his duel deck. As security guards escorted them out, The Sparrow suddenly descended from nowhere and rescued Yuma.
Is this deck yours because I know it isn't mine.
I must have dropped it. Thanks!
No need to thank me, although I do have a small request.
What is it?
I would like to challenge you to a lavish duel!
Awesome! You like to duel?
When I'm not saving the universe, yes.
Whaddya say we duel right now, Sparrow?
You really mean it? Great! By the way, my real name's Nelson.
Nelson was excited to duel with a friend. Unfortunately, Nelson's mother interrupted the two and escorted Yuma out.

That night, on the deck of his hotel room, Nelson came across a mysterious Number Card – Number 83: Galaxy Queen. When he picked it up, it overcame him, possessing him, making him believe he really was The Sparrow.
Soon, Yuma and Tori heard reports of The Sparrow running amok through the city. Tori grabbed Yuma and ran to the streets in search of The Sparrow.
What are we doing out here, Tori?
We’re out here to prove The Sparrow’s innocence! Tying random people up and flipping over cars? The Sparrow would never do stuff like that.
It wasn't long before Yuma and Tori came across Nelson, lurking the streets in the dead of night.
Nelson, why are you going around attacking people dressed up like The Sparrow?
I have to fulfill my duty to the Galaxy Queen. I swore to defeat the dark emperor Furious Max and his minions.
As for you, why have you come here? Has the dark emperor managed to sink his claws into you as well?
Snap out of it, Nelson!
If you are aligned with the dark emperor, then I have no choice but to battle you.
If you want a battle, I challenge you to a duel!
